forecast.generalSituationZh: 廣東明日風勢微弱，天色大致良好。受一股清勁的偏東氣流影響，隨後一兩日沿岸地區雲量較多及有幾陣雨，早晚較為潮濕。預料一道冷鋒會在下星期三橫過華南沿岸，該區北風增強，氣溫顯著下降。受隨後的東北季候風及一道雲帶影響，下週後期廣東沿岸早晚普遍清涼。
forecast.generalSituationEn: Winds will be weak and the weather will be mainly fine over Guangdong tomorrow. Under the influence of a fresh easterly airstream, it will be cloudier with a few rain patches over the coastal areas in the following couple of days, and will be relatively humid in the morning and at night. A cold front is expected to move across the coast of southern China next Wednesday. Winds will strengthen from the north and temperatures will fall appreciably over the region. Under the influence of the associated northeast monsoon and a band of clouds, it will be generally cool in the morning and at night over the coast of Guangdong in the latter part of next week.

days.weatherZh: 大致多雲，有一兩陣雨。日間部分時間天色明朗。
days.weatherEn: Mainly cloudy with one or two rain patches. Bright periods during the day.

days.weatherZh: 大致多雲。早上有一兩陣雨，日間短暫時間有陽光。

days.windZh: 東至東南風3至4級，初時離岸間中5級。
days.windEn: East to southeast force 3 to 4, occasionally force 5 offshore at first.

days.weatherZh: 大致多雲，有幾陣雨。初時局部地區能見度較低。稍後氣溫顯著下降。
days.weatherEn: Mainly cloudy with a few rain patches. Visibility relatively low in some areas at first. Temperatures will fall appreciably later.
days.windZh: 微風2級，漸轉北風4至5級，高地間中6級。
days.windEn: Light winds force 2, becoming north force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 on high ground.
